answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bond before it can transact; honest work slowly returns it, but detected collusion slashes it to zero. Spinning up a thousand sybils then costs a thousand bonds, a cost ridge no attacker scales cheaply. Reputation grows like a vein in marble, earned over time rather than minted, while random audit paths, unpredictable as scattered yarrow stalks, keep forged identities from safely coordinating.
